verses.gurmukhi: ਅਕੁ ਧਤੂਰਾ ਝਟੁਲਾ ਨੀਵਾ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਖੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: ak dhatooraa jhaTulaa neevaa hoi na dhubidhaa khoiee|

en.bdb: The akk, a poisonous plant of sandy region and thorn- apple though with branches lowered, yet do not discard their dubiety.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫੁਲਿ ਫੁਲਿ ਫੁਲੇ ਦੁਬਾਜਰੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਫਲ ਫਲਿ ਫਲਿ ਮੰਦੀ ਸੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: ful ful fule dhubaajare bikh fal fal fal ma(n)dhee soiee|

en.bdb: The hybrid plants apparently look blossommed but they have poisonous flowers and fruits which make them ill-reputed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੀਐ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਅਕੁ ਦੁਧੁ ਪੀਤੇ ਮਰੀਐ ਦੁਧੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: peeaai na koiee ak dhudh peete mareeaai dhudh na hoiee|

en.bdb: Drinking akk-milk, man dies. How could such secretion be called milk?

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਖੜੀਆਂ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੁਢੀਆਂ ਫਟਿ ਫਟਿ ਛੁਟਿ ਛੁਟਿ ਉਡਨਿ ਓਈ।
verses.translit_en: khakhaReeaa(n) vich buddeeaa(n) faT faT chhuT chhuT uddan oiee|

en.bdb: Out of their parts cotton-like pieces burst out and fly about.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਮਿਤਾਲਾ ਅਕ ਤਿਡੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਦੁਬਾਜਰਿਆਂ ਕਿਉ ਢੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: chitamitaalaa ak tidd milai dhubaajariaa(n) kiau ddoiee|

en.bdb: Akkhoppers are also piebald; they too like the double-minded , are nowhere sheltered.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਾਇ ਧਤੂਰਾ ਬਰਲੀਐ ਕਖ ਚੁਣੰਦਾ ਵਤੈ ਲੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: khai dhatooraa baraleeaai kakh chuna(n)dhaa vatai loiee|

en.bdb: Eating thornapple man goes mad and people see him gathering straw in the world.
Ratak,small red and black seeds, also get pierced through for making garlands.
